title: Badge Cloning — 125 kHz Signal Capture Confirmed

fields.summary: IT has confirmed the duplicate badge event is not a smart card copy. The cloned badge was registered via 125 kHz frequency on the iCLASS reader at Door S-4, not the encrypted 13.56 MHz used by the legitimate card. This confirms a Proxmark3-style attack: the attacker captured the unencrypted 125 kHz legacy credential from Carlos Mendez’s badge during a prior access event and wrote it to a blank T5577 card. The 125 kHz signal was read at V-1 on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 10:22. The original Mendez badge was not compromised; the attacker exploited the dual-frequency legacy capability for backward compatibility. The clone was used to access Electrical Room B at 07:38, where a rogue wireless access point was later discovered.
